description: Lists single-borrower (SASB) CMBS and CRE CLO deals named in public SEC filings, newest first: the issuing entity, its Form ABS-15G filing date, the depositor or sponsor, the loan and property counts the accountants' report gives, and links to every filing. With deal set it returns one deal and, for a CRE CLO whose REIT sponsor filed the indenture, the closing-date loan list, checked against the filing's own total. Use it for private deals, which file no monthly reports; use search_loans for loans in public trusts. Without a key it returns only how many deals are on file.

deal.description: A deal id from a previous answer (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens), for that one deal and its loan list

limit.description: Deals per call: default 100, up to 400 with a key

q.description: Word starts in the deal, depositor or sponsor name, e.g. "BX" or "TRTX"

year.description: Year of the first ABS-15G filing, e.g. "2026"

name: sasb_clo_deals
title: Single-borrower CMBS and CRE CLO deals
